caption: The drawing depicts a horizontal rectangular section of fabric with a decorative floral pattern. The design consists of several stylized flowers, leaves, and curved stems rendered in shades of blue, navy, and light teal. The flowers have rounded petals with dot and dash details, and the composition features both five-petaled and multi-petaled blossoms interspersed with leaf shapes. Wavy lines in dark blue create movement across the fabric, connecting the flowers and leaves. The entire patterned section is bordered along the top and bottom by a blue, cross-hatched or lattice border. The decorative area is set against a beige background, which frames the patterned fabric above and below, with the floral motif filling the central strip. The overall appearance is that of an embroidered or printed textile with a repeating floral design in cool hues on a light, neutral base.
title: Bedspread
